title: My personal feedback
body: Hi! I love this app, I’m not sure if you’re going to read this but I hope you do. I love this app but there’s one thing I think that can be changed and would be really helpful to me. You know when the app tells us to choose a priority, and you can only have 1 red 2 oranges. The thing is I already used red for school work but I also need to keep track of my hygiene which should be a red. Not that I’m dirty or anything but because sometimes I’m lazy and if the next day I forgot if I had shower the other day then I can check this app.i want to put all those red but I can’t. You say”oh then just put it orange”nope I can’t I using that for tuition work. So I was wondering if you could just let us choose the colour ourself and not give us a max amount. I’m not saying this is a must, but to me if I put hygiene as yellow it’s just wrong. So please if you can and if you’re reading this please change it. Thank you!
